main_body: sci-fi metal floor and wall panel tiles (4x3 grid of 16x16 terrain tiles)
top_band: rows 0-47 across all 3 rows of 16x16 metal floor/panel tiles
evidence: This is a 4x3 grid of 16x16 sci-fi metal floor/panel terrain tiles. As terrain/ground tiles, they correctly fill the entire 16x16 cell per tile with top-down / flat surface plating, rivets, recessed hatches, and small glowing nodes.

style.evidence: The sci-fi metal tiles use a 6-step blue-grey ramp plus a 4-step cyan glow ramp on the 4th column. Each 16x16 panel has beveled top/left highlights, bottom/right shadows, rivets, surface scratches, seam lines, or recessed vents, avoiding large flat fills. However, the 3 rows of tiles are identical vertical repetitions of the first row, making the 4x3 patch slightly less varied than the Beodeul reference.
